setup.title: Initial Setup

welcome.heading: Welcome to {appName}
welcome.description: This wizard prepares your installation. It checks all services and creates the first Owner account.

database.heading: Database verification
database.description: Migrations are applied automatically when the backend container starts. No manual SQL is required.
database.notReady: The database is not ready. Check the backend logs before continuing.

owner.heading: Create the Owner account
owner.description: The Owner has every permission and cannot be removed.
owner.setupCodeHint: Printed in the backend log at startup (docker compose logs backend). It proves you control this installation.
owner.passwordTooShort: The password must contain at least 12 characters.

velocity.heading: Connect your Velocity proxy
velocity.description: Generate a single-use registration token and enter it in the Velocity plugin configuration. The token expires after 30 minutes and becomes invalid once used.

finish.heading: Setup complete
finish.description: Your network management platform is ready.

setup.alreadyInitialized: This installation has already been initialized.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: The backend could not be reached.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
errors.notFound: The requested resource was not found.

players.title: Players
players.subtitle: Everyone who has joined the network.
players.onlineSubtitle: Players connected right now. Updates live.
players.search: Search by name, previous name or UUID
players.count: {count, plural, =0 {No players} one {# player} other {# players}}

profile.ipHidden: Connection data requires the players.view.ip permission.
profile.notFound: This player has never joined the network.

servers.title: Servers
servers.subtitle: Velocity proxies and Paper servers connected to the network.
servers.name: Name
servers.disabledHint: Disabled servers are rejected by the backend until re-enabled.
servers.rotateConfirm: The current credentials stop working immediately. Continue?
servers.rotated: New credentials for {server}. Replace credentials.properties on the server with the values below and restart it. They are shown only once.
servers.revokeConfirm: The server will be disconnected until it registers again. Continue?
servers.removeConfirm: Delete {server}? Its connection history is removed as well. This cannot be undone.
servers.nameHint: Backend servers must use the same name as in velocity.toml so server switches can be matched.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.subtitle: Network-wide punishments issued in game and in the dashboard.
moderation.search: Search player, staff member, reason or ID
moderation.revokeDescription: The punishment ends immediately on all servers.
moderation.playerOffline: Only online players can be kicked.
moderation.playerNotFound: This player has never joined the network.
moderation.blacklistHint: Also blocks the last known IP address of this player.

notes.title: Internal notes
notes.description: Visible to staff only. Never shown to the player.

profileTabs.planned: {tab} will be available in a later release. Nothing is shown until real data is collected.

activity.noData: No sessions recorded in this period.

connections.relatedAccounts: Other accounts on these IP addresses
connections.relatedHint: Accounts that connected from at least one of this player's IP addresses. Shared networks (households, schools, VPNs) are common; treat this as a hint, not proof.
connections.approximate: Approximate, derived from the IP address. Not an exact location.
connections.geoipDisabled: IP geolocation is not configured (see the installation guide).
connections.ipPermission: IP addresses require the players.view.ip permission.
connections.locationPermission: Location data requires the players.view.location permission.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Data minimisation for personal data collected by the plugins.
privacy.ipRetentionHint: Older IP addresses are removed from connection records and the audit log every hour. Approximate country and network are kept. Blacklist entries are not affected.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.subtitle: Network-wide statistics collected by the Paper servers.
stats.noData: No statistics have been collected for this player yet.
stats.networkNoData: No statistics have been collected yet. Install the Paper plugin with statistics enabled.
stats.partial: Statistics are collected since {date}. Earlier activity is not included in this range.

anticheat.title: AntiCheat
anticheat.subtitle: Reports from AntiCheat integrations and the rules that decide punishments.
anticheat.enabledHint: When disabled, reports are still recorded but nothing is punished.
anticheat.collectEvidenceHint: Evidence text and details sent by integrations are stored with events and punishments.
anticheat.maxPerMinute: Max. automatic punishments per server and minute
anticheat.defaultRuleHint: Applies to automatic reports whose check has no rule. "Log only" is recommended.
anticheat.commandFallbackHint: Applies to explicit /anticheatban requests whose check has no rule.
anticheat.rulesHint: Checks are matched case-insensitively against the name the integration reports.
anticheat.examplesHint: Examples: Speed 30 days, Fly 14 days, KillAura permanent. Review them before saving.
anticheat.noRules: No rules yet. Reports are handled by the defaults above.
anticheat.saved: AntiCheat settings saved. They apply to the next report.
anticheat.readOnly: You can view the rules but need the anticheat.manage permission to change them.

inventory.noSnapshot: No snapshot has been recorded on this server yet. Snapshots are sent when the player joins or leaves a Paper server.
inventory.refreshHint: Only possible while the player is online on this server.
inventory.refreshRequested: Snapshot requested. It arrives within a few seconds.
inventory.offlineNotice: The player is not on this server. Changes are queued and applied safely when they next join it.
inventory.onlineNotice: The player is online on this server. Changes are applied within a few seconds.
inventory.pending: A change is waiting to be applied.
inventory.selectHint: Select a slot to inspect or edit it. Drag items to move or swap them.
inventory.name: Custom name
inventory.changes: {count, plural, =0 {No changes} one {# changed slot} other {# changed slots}}
inventory.reason: Reason (optional, stored in the audit log)
inventory.saved: Change queued. It is applied only if the affected slots are still unchanged in game.
inventory.readOnly: Viewing only. Editing requires the players.edit.inventory permission.
inventory.rollbackConfirm: Restore the slots of this change to their previous items? This is applied only if they are still unchanged in game.
inventory.invalidId: Use a namespaced ID such as minecraft:diamond_sword.
inventory.conflictHint: Nothing was changed: the inventory changed in game first.

errors.STALE_REVISION: The inventory changed meanwhile. The latest snapshot has been loaded; please redo your change.
errors.PENDING_EDIT: Another change is still waiting to be applied.
errors.STALE_SLOT: A slot changed meanwhile. Reload and try again.
errors.PLAYER_NOT_ON_SERVER: The player is not online on this server.
